summary: This 8-K filing by PIMCO Global StocksPLUS & Income Fund (ticker PGP) reports a board-approved change to the fund's 80% investment policy, effective August 28, 2026. The policy now permits the fund to invest at least 80% of net assets in a global portfolio of equity and/or income-producing investments, with expanded definitions of eligible securities including various fixed-income instruments and derivatives. No merger, acquisition, capital return, or special situation event is involved. The filing is a routine operational disclosure of an investment mandate change, not a special situation.
